scripts.check: pnpm run prepare:official-sdk && pnpm run typecheck:prepared && pnpm run test:prepared
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && node scripts/packed-manifest.mjs prepare
scripts.test: pnpm run prepare:official-sdk && pnpm run test:prepared
scripts.test:quality-campaign:production-runner: pnpm run build && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vitest run test/quality-campaign-production-runner-structural.test.ts -t 'runs 3x240' --no-file-parallelism --pool=threads --test-timeout=180000 && vitest run test/quality-campaign-production-runner-structural.test.ts -t 'durably blocks' --no-file-parallelism --pool=threads --test-timeout=180000 && vitest run test/quality-campaign-production-runner-structural.test.ts -t 'rejects substituted custody' --no-file-parallelism --pool=threads --test-timeout=180000 && vitest run test/quality-campaign-installed-package.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --pool=threads --test-timeout=180000
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run prepare:official-sdk && pnpm run typecheck:prepared
scripts.typecheck:prepared: pnpm run build && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
